name: Worst Mistakes / Projected Recursive Teaching Dimension
details: For finite concept classes, $\mathrm{M}_{\mathrm{worst}}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{RTD}^{p}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: Corollary 8(2) of Doliwa--Fan--Simon--Zilles states $\mathrm{RTD}^{*}(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm{Mopt}(\mathcal H)$.  Their $\mathrm{RTD}^{*}$ is the maximum recursive teaching dimension over coordinate projections, the catalogue's projected recursive teaching dimension, and $\mathrm{Mopt}$ is the catalogue's worst-mistakes parameter.
